meta.method: Complete statewide universe of incorporated Maine municipalities where the OCP municipal opt-in model (refreshed 2026-07-09, maine.gov/dafs/ocp/open-data/adult-use/opt-in-communities) records retail authorization. dispensaries_operating = distinct active adult-use Store license IDs per the OCP roster retrieved 2026-08-11 (source URL filename dated 2026-07-01; HTTP Last-Modified 2026-08-10), grouped by canonical host municipality; known roster place-name aliases (Stratton→Eustis, Hollis Center→Hollis, Greenville Junction→Greenville) are normalized. Store licenses in municipalities without OCP-recorded retail authorization are excluded pending reconciliation. year_opted_in and license_fee_usd are populated only where independently retained from the prior reviewed subset; null means not yet verified. Bar Harbor and Wells are excluded because voters rejected retail in 2022 and 2025; see the corrections log.
